<form
  class="flex flex-col gap-3 items-start"
  onsubmit="
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('rating-out').value = 'Submitted score: ' + (new FormData(this).get('review') ?? 'none');
  "
>
  <label class="label">Your review</label>
  <fieldset class="rating" aria-label="Your review">
    <label class="rating-item"
      ><input class="rating-input" type="radio" name="review" value="1" aria-label="1 star"
    /></label>
    <label class="rating-item"
      ><input class="rating-input" type="radio" name="review" value="2" aria-label="2 stars"
    /></label>
    <label class="rating-item"
      ><input class="rating-input" type="radio" name="review" value="3" aria-label="3 stars"
    /></label>
    <label class="rating-item"
      ><input class="rating-input" type="radio" name="review" value="4" aria-label="4 stars"
    /></label>
    <label class="rating-item"
      ><input class="rating-input" type="radio" name="review" value="5" aria-label="5 stars"
    /></label>
  </fieldset>
  <button class="btn" data-size="sm" type="submit">Submit</button>
  <output class="text-sm text-muted-foreground" id="rating-out"></output>
</form>
